csv_scope_of_work: Project consists of the construction of a new parking deck structure and surface lot refurbishments for approximately 500 spaces and includes related site improvements for traffic flow. The existing parking lot has approximately 159 spaces. It is anticipated that the new deck will be ground plus three levels and will leave space for surface parking and drive lanes. Consideration should be given to allow adequate space next to an existing non-sprinklered building to maintain code required building separation. The deck and sitework will be oriented to allow easy vehicular access to adjacent Randall Drive and Racine Drive. Exterior aesthetic is to match that of existing UNCW parking decks
